task.title: P6-125: Give the vendored Dialog a Tab focus trap
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 3 — Leverage: fixes that retire a whole class). Original id: P6-125. Size: M. Specs: specs/ui-components.md, specs/app-ui.md.

**Give the vendored `Dialog` a Tab focus trap — it is missing, and the gap reaches all four Dialog consumers** (was `P6-028a`). `palette.rs:1113-1123` focuses the field on open but installs nothing to keep focus, so `Tab` walks out of the dialog into the page behind the scrim, against the design's "the palette holds focus while open". Verified 2026-07-30 that this is a **`dialog.rs`-level gap, not palette-specific** — fixing it there fixes every `Dialog` in the app; it does **not** reach `Sheet` or `Popover`, which have their own stories.
